verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static per-language code samples in the quickstart, a public OpenAPI spec (a developer building block that its own README says is primarily for internal use), and a dashboard that can run queries. None of these is an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: an interactive API reference, in-browser runnable or try-it examples for API endpoints, and any independent corroboration of such a feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Each language carries a full write/query code sample in the quickstart.
